title: Rating
description: A score in stars on bits-ui RatingGroup: one tab stop with the slider role. The chosen stars are filled in copper (the value in hand), the rest are outlines; a half (allowHalf) fills the left half of a star. Hover previews the rating in a lighter copper (not on touch); a change of several stars sweeps star by star, 35ms apart, left to right as it fills and right to left as it empties (none under reduced motion). Sizes sm (a readonly display in a list), default and lg. Keyboard: arrows by one or a half, Home and End, typed digits. readonly shows without taking (still focusable, with aria-readonly); disabled at 45%. The consumer gives the name and aria-valuetext, with no English default. In a form it submits with a name, and form.reset() puts it back to the mount value. bind:value may point at an undefined value: it reads as 0. After Klementine's Rating.
